svg.text: 16 · A double exposure · the eye: Top alone (R9)
A click on a row’s eye shows that exposure as it develops by itself. The lit eye is the accent (a state); the other row’s eye is struck and the row dims. Click again for both, or the other
It is the page’s state: nothing is written or undone, and an export is always the double. The picture’s tag and the status line say “Top alone”.

g.text: The bottom sets the frame and the date
The frame’s size and shape are the bottom exposure’s.
